Musashi Seimitsu.why: Its Energy Solution business (Musashi Energy Solutions) makes Hybrid SuperCapacitors (HSC) that absorb the steep power fluctuations of AI data-center clusters; it is expanding HSC capacity (Hokuto Plant expansion, new Minami-Alps Plant handed over June 2026) to meet that demand, so AI data-center power build-outs drive its new growth pillar.
Musashi Seimitsu.evidence: Musashi Seimitsu results presentation: FY2026 First Quarter (08-06-2026): 'HSC: key infrastructure for power quality in AI data centers'; 'Yamanashi Hokuto Plant: capacity expansion underway / Yamanashi Minami-Alps Plant: handover in June 2026 ... Strengthening production capability to meet robust demand'.

players.product: Hybrid SuperCapacitor (HSC) (Musashi Energy Solutions) for AI data-center power peak shaving

quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half April-September 2025 of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 168,545 million (-2.8% YoY), operating profit JPY 8,498 million (+8.4%), ordinary profit JPY 7,964 million (+27.4%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 4,332 million (+45.8%). Segments (sales / segment profit): Japan JPY 19,302 million (+3.9%) / JPY 728 million (-36.4%), as upfront investment costs for the Energy Solution business grew; Americas JPY 54,735 million (+5.4%) / JPY 2,673 million (-5.3%), also with Energy Solution upfront costs; Asia JPY 38,196 million (-5.6%) / JPY 4,218 million (-0.6%), two-wheeler sales firm but FX negative; China JPY 14,151 million (-4.2%) / JPY 217 million (loss of JPY 322 million a year earlier); Europe JPY 42,158 million (-11.6%) / JPY 652 million (JPY 15 million a year earlier). H1 R&D JPY 2,543 million.

quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): in regions hit by US tariff policy, customers are rebuilding production and supply, raising needs to shift to local production and inquiries to Musashi, and the company is studying stronger production infrastructure in its main regions; in Europe the structural reform consolidates production sites and right-sizes fixed costs. For AI data centers, where demand for hybrid supercapacitors (HSC) is growing rapidly, it is building an HSC production-increase system, and from this half it consolidates the newly established Musashi Energy Solutions North America, Inc. (Americas segment).
